body: MDXComponentsContext (packages/mdx-viewer/src/components-context.tsx) exists specifically for React PORTALS: TaskDetailSheet renders task detail markdown via a separate ReactMarkdown instance inside a portal; portals inherit React-tree context not DOM, so it calls useMDXComponents() to reuse the same components map and render <Chart>/<Stats>/<ADR> instead of literal tags. Any new portal that renders markdown must do the same.
